plans.title: Live Metadata Path Fix — transport, proxy, and risk-control-safe page call
notes: Plan opened 2026-09-11 from the live-verification diagnosis of the delivered metadata stack.

Three reproduced defects: D1 no HTTP backend declared (bilibili-api-python 17.4.2 requires curl_cffi/httpx/aiohttp); D2 the pinned package disables env proxies by default (proxies={"all": ""}), so this proxied host times out; D3 the library's page call uses dm=True plus w_webid=None (dynamic page no longer emits __RENDER_DATA__) -> HTTP 412 risk control.
Verified working shape (order-swapped): Api(wbi=True, dm=False) with w_webid="" -> code=0, vlist=5, page.count=1691.
